description: Polish mobile responsiveness, add Framer Motion animations, run comprehensive integration testing. Ensure all components responsive (<md breakpoint), animations smooth, no console errors, accessibility.
steps: Mobile responsiveness: audit all components for mobile (<sm 640px, md 768px breakpoints). Hero stacks vertically, FilterBar chip scroll or dropdown, GameCards full-width single column, Leaderboard card view, Bracket horizontal scroll, Carousels 1 visible card

Add Framer Motion animations: page load (hero fade-in 0.5s, stats animate 0-target 1s staggered, content fade-in 0.5s delay), bracket modal slide-up on mobile/center on desktop, live score pulse (200ms), filter apply cross-fade (100ms), carousel drag-to-swipe
Card hover effects: shadow deepens, scale 1.02x, 150-200ms ease-out
Verify touch interactions: min tap target 44×44px, swipe gestures (Framer Motion drag), long-press modals (optional)
Performance audit: lazy-load components (next/dynamic), code-split bracket rendering, monitor React DevTools Profiler for slow renders

Comprehensive manual testing: page load (no errors), all sections visible (responsive), game join (free/paid/guest), filter changes update list, leaderboard period filter, player profile modal open/close, follow/block actions, WebSocket updates (or polling fallback), animations smooth (60fps), error toasts
Browser testing: Chrome, Safari, Firefox (mobile iOS Safari, mobile Chrome, desktop versions)
Accessibility: ARIA labels on buttons/filters/modals, keyboard navigation Tab through filters → games → leaderboard, color contrast WCAG AA, screen reader test (read page structure)
acceptance_criteria: Page renders correctly on mobile (<sm), tablet (md), desktop (lg) viewports
All animations play smoothly (60fps, no jank) verified in DevTools Performance tab
Touch interactions work: tap (44×44 min), swipe (carousel), long-press (modals optional)

Full manual test suite passes: hero renders, filters work, games update, tournaments visible, leaderboard searchable/sortable, player profiles open, follow/block buttons work, WebSocket updates or polling fallback, no console errors
Browser compatibility: renders correctly in Chrome, Safari, Firefox
Accessibility: ARIA labels present, keyboard navigation works, color contrast meets WCAG AA
Performance: Largest Contentful Paint < 3s, no layout thrashing
All animations use CSS transforms + opacity (GPU-accelerated)
verification: Run yarn dev, open DevTools, console tab
Load http://localhost:3000/games, verify no errors in console
Verify all sections visible and responsive on mobile (< 640px viewport)
Test game join flow: click 'Join Free' on free game, verify join succeeds
Apply filters: select sport, skill level, verify games list updates
Leaderboard: change period to 'Month', verify data refreshes, search for player by name
Player profile: click leaderboard player name, modal opens, verify stats display correctly
Follow: click 'Follow' button, verify POST /api/social/follow called, button updates
WebSocket: check DevTools Network > WS, verify connection, watch ping frames every 30s
Animations: watch page load, verify stats counters animate smoothly (1s per counter), bracket open/close smooth slide
Performance: open DevTools Performance tab, record page load, verify no long tasks, LCP < 3s
Accessibility: Tab through page, verify keyboard navigation works, check contrast with color picker tool
